title: The Touched Locust Turns Monster: The Birth of the Swarm
summary: Describes how the desert locust, when its hind legs are touched again and again in a crowd, gets a surge of serotonin and within a few hours turns from a shy, solitary insect into one that migrates in swarms. This phenomenon is called phase polyphenism. The episode explains how Uvarov showed in nineteen twenty-one that locusts thought to be two separate species were in fact the same species, the serotonin experiment published in Science in two thousand nine, the four-VA aggregation pheromone discovered in twenty twenty, and how marching swarms find their direction through the fear of being eaten by one another.
